## How to Sign

To sign this CLA, please add your information to the `.github/cla-signatures.json` file via a pull request. The format should be:

```json
{
  "signatures": [
    {
      "name": "Your Full Name",
      "email": "your.email@example.com",
      "github": "your-github-username",
      "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
      "contribution_url": "https://github.com/lazypod/lazypod/pull/1"
    }
  ]
}
```

Alternatively, you may sign by commenting on your pull request with:

```
I have read and agree to the Contributor License Agreement (CLA).
Name: Your Full Name
Email: your.email@example.com
Date: YYYY-MM-DD
```

A GitHub Action will verify your signature before your pull request can be merged.
